worked_trace.heading: Worked reconciliation: the imagined aisle is clear, the sensor sees a pallet
worked_trace.maximum_inference: A proposed interface can keep forecasts, qualified observation assertions, grants and effects distinct; no live control, measurement truth or causal prevention follows.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: A competent reactive controller with qualified obstacle sensing, a current grant, outcome observation and an ordinary event log can supply the same bounded stop. Prefer ordinary control at equal or better behavior and lower burden.
readable_claim:
A prediction remains a model-relative hypothesis. Compare it
with qualified observations without turning either a coherent forecast or an
admitted reading into unquestionable reality.
normative_rule:
Bind consequential rollout use to its model, observation
basis, branch, intervention, horizon, uncertainty and validity limits. Check
current use eligibility and the applicable action grant separately. Route
material disagreement before further affected action; preserve permitted
forecast and outcome history, including unresolved effects.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The scene states once that reconciliation architecture is not prediction or sensor truth.
